title: 第5章 赌石暴富第6章 无商不奸
lines: 李卓阳觉得有些不敢相信，于是拿起玄天宝鉴，对准了货架上的一块赤炎石。
瞬息间，脑海中就显示了一道信息：赤炎石一块，一阶灵材，可用于炼制法器。
嗯，不错不错，跟祖父登记的信息一模一样。
然后又对准一块冰魄石：冰魄石一块，一阶灵材，可用于炼制法器。
没错，也是一模一样。
再对准一块精金：太乙精金一块，二阶灵材，可用于炼制灵器。
嗯？不对吧。
李卓阳拿起记录矿石的卡片看到，精金一块，一阶灵材，可用于炼制法器。
祖父记录的是精金，宝鉴说的是太乙精金，这不一致啊。
难道祖父错了？还是说这块精金中，另有玄虚？
精金乃一阶灵材，太乙精金确实实打实的二阶灵材！
其价值相差何止十倍！
正常的二阶灵材，都要三四千灵石起步，像太乙精金这样的，估计至少能卖五千块灵石！
想到这里，李卓阳心里一阵火热，这块精金里面若真的有一块太乙精金的话，那他可是要大发一笔。
祖父去世后留下的灵材虽然不少，但这几年为了修炼，李卓阳几乎都卖掉了，但都是一阶的，二阶的他从未见过。
李卓阳此时急迫地想打开精金证实一下，但是精金是天下最坚硬的炼器材料之一，太乙精金更是坚硬无比，他一个炼气三层的小修士，想切开，是万万不可能的。
除非有冰魄蚕丝这天下至柔之物，以柔克刚才能将之切开。
冰魄蚕丝可不是常见之物，至少李卓阳目前手上没有。
这让李卓阳有点心痒难挠，就如同手中抱着一只藏宝箱，却没有钥匙能打开一样。
过了片刻，李卓阳啪一声拍了一下脑袋。
太乙精金验证不了，我可以去验证紫阳石啊。
紫阳矿赌石场那么多矿石，可以随意去尝试鉴宝啊。
李卓阳想到此，又兴奋了起来，拿着玄天宝鉴爱不释手地反复查看，真真是捧在手里怕化了的感觉。
把玩一阵，他将储物袋祭出，准备将玄天宝鉴收藏起来。
不过法诀掐出后，玄天宝鉴毫无动静。
这东西居然不能收纳进储物袋！
李卓阳虽感觉无语，但好在此物也不大，就拿个绳子绑了起来，挂在脖子里，仿佛一个平安符一般。
玄天宝鉴贴到肌肤的一瞬间，李卓阳顿时感觉一股清凉从心口传来，继而顺着经脉上行到了双眼之处。
继而李卓阳感觉眼前一亮，似乎对周遭万物能看得更清楚了些。
他将目光转向适才看过的精金上，这时脑中便显现出了一句话。
“太乙精金一块，二阶灵材，可用于炼制灵器。”
原来此物贴身收藏，居然有此妙用。
李卓阳原本还担心拿着玄天宝鉴照着宝物太过扎眼，如此一来，短期是不用担心宝物暴露了。
次日一早，李卓阳就出现在了紫阳矿区，只不过他来得似乎过早了一些，那些赌石场还没开门。
来都来了，不如再进矿洞挖一次吧。
李卓阳想着，便随意进了一处矿洞。
到达采矿点后，李卓阳便心不在焉地一铲一铲刨着洞壁。
忽然，他的眼前似乎有一团紫光晕显现，李卓阳精神一震，一铲子朝那里刨去。
“哗啦啦”的几声后，洞壁一阵碎石落地，一个泛着紫色微光的石头掉落了下来。
紫阳石！
李卓阳连忙将之捡起，再三查看后发现，确实是紫阳石！
content_en:
Li Zhuoyang felt a little unbelievable, so he picked up the Xuantian Baojian and pointed it at a red flame stone on the shelf.
In an instant, a piece of information appeared in his mind: a red flame stone, a first-level spiritual material, which can be used to refine magic weapons.
Well, not bad, it is exactly the same as the information registered by my grandfather.
Then he aimed at a piece of ice soul stone: a piece of ice soul stone, a first-level spiritual material, which can be used to refine magic weapons.
Yes, it's exactly the same.
Then aim at a piece of fine gold: a piece of Taiyi fine gold, a second-level spiritual material that can be used to refine spiritual weapons.
Um? That's not right.
Li Zhuoyang picked up the card recording the ore and saw a piece of fine gold, a first-level spiritual material that could be used to refine magic weapons.
My grandfather recorded it as fine gold, but Baojian said it was Taiyi fine gold. This is inconsistent.
Could it be that grandpa was wrong? Or is there something more mysterious in this piece of fine gold?
Fine gold is a first-level spiritual material, and Taiyi fine gold is a real second-level spiritual material!
The difference in value is more than ten times!
Normal second-level spiritual materials start with three to four thousand spiritual stones. Something like Taiyi Fine Gold can probably be sold for at least five thousand spiritual stones!
Thinking of this, Li Zhuoyang felt hot in his heart. If there was really a piece of Taiyi fine gold in this piece of fine gold, then he would make a fortune.
Although there were a lot of spiritual materials left behind by his grandfather after his death, Li Zhuoyang sold almost all of them in order to practice in the past few years, but they were all first-level ones. He had never seen second-level ones.
Li Zhuoyang urgently wanted to open the fine gold to confirm, but fine gold is one of the hardest materials for refining weapons in the world, and Taiyi fine gold is even harder. As a young monk at the third level of Qi refining, it was absolutely impossible for him to cut through it.
Unless there is ice soul silk, the softest thing in the world, it can be cut through with softness overcoming hardness.
Ice soul silk is not a common thing, at least Li Zhuoyang doesn't have it on hand at the moment.
This made Li Zhuoyang feel a little itchy, just like holding a treasure box in his hand but having no key to open it.
After a while, Li Zhuoyang slapped his head.
Taiyi Fine Gold cannot be verified, but I can verify Purple Sunstone.
There are so many ores in the Ziyang Mine Stone Gambling Ground, you can try to identify the treasures at will.
Li Zhuoyang became excited again when he thought of this. He held the Xuantian Baojian and looked at it over and over again. He really felt like he was melting in his hands.
After playing with it for a while, he took out the storage bag and prepared to store the Xuantian Baojian.
However, after the magic formula was pinched out, there was no movement from Xuantian Baojian.
This thing can't be stored in a storage bag!
Although Li Zhuoyang felt speechless, fortunately the thing was not big, so he tied it up with a rope and hung it around his neck, like a peace charm.
The moment Xuantian Baojian touched his skin, Li Zhuoyang suddenly felt a coolness coming from his heart, and then traveling up his meridians to his eyes.
Then Li Zhuoyang felt his eyes light up, and he seemed to be able to see everything around him more clearly.
He turned his gaze to the fine gold he had just looked at, and then a sentence appeared in his mind.
"A piece of Taiyi fine gold, a second-level spiritual material, which can be used to refine spiritual weapons."
It turns out that this thing is stored close to the body, and it has such a wonderful use.
Li Zhuoyang was originally worried that holding the Xuantian Treasure Mirror to illuminate the treasure would be too eye-catching. In this way, he no longer had to worry about the treasure being exposed in the short term.
Early the next morning, Li Zhuoyang appeared in the Ziyang Mining Area, but he seemed to have arrived a little too early, as the stone gambling dens had not yet opened.
We’ve already come, why not go into the mine and dig again.
Li Zhuoyang thought about it and randomly entered a mine.
After arriving at the mining site, Li Zhuoyang absentmindedly dug at the cave wall with a shovel.
Suddenly, a purple halo seemed to appear in front of his eyes. Li Zhuoyang was shocked and dug there with a shovel.
After a few "crash" sounds, a burst of gravel fell to the ground from the cave wall, and a purple shimmering stone fell down.
Ziyang stone!
Li Zhuoyang quickly picked it up and after checking it again, he found that it was indeed a purple sun stone!
title_en: Chapter 5: Bet on Stones and Get Rich Chapter 6: There is no businessman but no treachery
